  "source": [
    "FUNCTION RPY_DYNPRO_CVT_INTO_EXTFORMAT.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(HEADER_INT) LIKE  D020S STRUCTURE  D020S",
    "*\"     VALUE(DESCRIPT) LIKE  D020T-DTXT",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(HEADER) LIKE  RPY_DYHEAD STRUCTURE  RPY_DYHEAD",
    "*\"  TABLES",
    "*\"      FIELDS_TO_CONTAINERS TYPE  DYFATC_TAB OPTIONAL",
    "*\"      FIELDS_INT STRUCTURE  D021S",
    "*\"      CONTAINERS TYPE  DYCATT_TAB OPTIONAL",
    "*\"      PARAMS STRUCTURE  RPY_DYPARA OPTIONAL",
    "*\"      PARAMS_INT STRUCTURE  D023S",
    "*\"  EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"      NOT_EXECUTED",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "  DATA: TI_STXT LIKE D021S-STXT,",
    "        F_LENG LIKE D021S-LENG,",
    "        r_property_bag type ref to cl_dynpro_property_bag,",
    "        r_cntcmp type ref to cl_dynpro_control_composite.",
    "",
    "* 0. Dynpro auf Niveau Release 3 heben,",
    "*    Feldtexte mit '_' auffüllen",
    "*    und LANF- und AUTH-Werte normalisieren;",
    "*    Dynpro-Release-Stand bestimmen",
    "",
    "* upgrade auf aktuelles Niveau",
    "  call function 'RS_SCRP_UPGRADE_DYNPRO'",
    "         tables",
    "              f       = fields_int",
    "              m       = params_int",
    "         changing",
    "              h       = header_int.",
    "",
    "  LOOP AT FIELDS_INT.",
    "    MOVE FIELDS_INT-STXT TO TI_STXT.",
    "    TRANSLATE TI_STXT USING ' _'.",
    "    IF FIELDS_INT-FILL NE 'R'.",
    "      F_LENG = FIELDS_INT-LENG.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      F_LENG = FIELDS_INT-LENG - 1.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    WRITE TI_STXT TO FIELDS_INT-STXT(F_LENG).",
    "    MODIFY FIELDS_INT.",
    "  ENDLOOP.",
    "",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'RS_DYNPRO_RELEASE_GET'",
    "       EXPORTING",
    "            DYNPRO_HEADER  = HEADER_INT",
    "       IMPORTING",
    "            DYNPRO_RELEASE = DYNPRO_RELEASE",
    "       EXCEPTIONS",
    "            OTHERS         = 1.",
    "  DYNP_REL = DYNPRO_RELEASE.",
    "",
    "* Property Bag instanziieren",
    "  create object r_property_bag",
    "    exporting",
    "      d023s = params_int[]",
    "    exceptions",
    "      others = 1.",
    "  if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "    MESSAGE ID SY-MSGID TYPE SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO",
    "               WITH SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4",
    "            raising not_executed.",
    "  endif.",
    "* Control Composite instanziieren",
    "  create object r_cntcmp",
    "    exporting",
    "      d023s = params_int[]",
    "    exceptions",
    "      others = 1.",
    "  if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "    MESSAGE ID SY-MSGID TYPE SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO",
    "               WITH SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4",
    "            raising not_executed.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "*-----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "* 1. externe Tabelle der Dynprofelder",
    "*-----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "",
    "* universellen Container (DYNPRO-Container) als ersten Cont. einrichten",
    "  REFRESH CONTAINERS.",
    "  CLEAR   CONTAINERS.",
    "  CONTAINERS-TYPE = RPYTY_DYNP_CTYPE-SCREEN.",
    "  CONTAINERS-NAME = CONT_SCREEN_NAME.",
    "  APPEND CONTAINERS.",
    "",
    "* Feldliste initialisieren",
    "  REFRESH FIELDS_TO_CONTAINERS.",
    "  FIELDLIST_INT[] = FIELDS_INT[].",
    "* falls ein internes Feld keinen Namen hat, bekommt es einen",
    "* automatisch generierten",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'RS_SCRP_FIELDS_AUTOTEXT'",
    "       EXPORTING",
    "            NAME_ALL_FIELDS = 'X'",
    "       TABLES",
    "            FIELDS  = FIELDLIST_INT",
    "       EXCEPTIONS",
    "            OTHERS  = 1.",
    "",
    "* Schleife über die interne Feldliste. Dabei wird jedes Feld der",
    "* internen Feldliste in die erweiterte int. Feldliste umgesetzt",
    "* und einem Container zugeordnet, der bei Bedarf angelegt wird.",
    "  REFRESH FIELDLIST_INT_EXTEND.",
    "  LOOP AT FIELDLIST_INT.",
    "    FIELD_INT = FIELDLIST_INT.",
    "    PERFORM R_FIND_CONTAINER_TO_FIELD",
    "                      TABLES   CONTAINERS",
    "                               FIELDLIST_INT",
    "                      USING    FIELD_INT",
    "                      CHANGING CONT_ATTR.",
    "    MOVE FIELD_INT TO FIELDLIST_INT_EXTEND.",
    "    FIELDLIST_INT_EXTEND-CONT_NAME = CONT_ATTR-NAME.",
    "    FIELDLIST_INT_EXTEND-CONT_TYPE = CONT_ATTR-TYPE.",
    "    APPEND FIELDLIST_INT_EXTEND.",
    "  ENDLOOP.",
    "",
    "* Schleife über die neu angelegten Container des Dynpros",
    "",
    "  LOOP AT CONTAINERS.",
    "    CONT_ATTR = CONTAINERS.",
    "",
    "*   Attribute des Containers werden aus den Attributen der zu ihnen",
    "*   gehörenden Felder zusammengesetzt",
    "    PERFORM R_COMPLETE_CONTAINER_ATTR",
    "                      TABLES   FIELDLIST_INT_EXTEND",
    "                               CONTAINERS",
    "                               params_int",
    "                      USING    CONT_ATTR",
    "                               r_property_bag",
    "                               r_cntcmp",
    "                               HEADER_INT.",
    "    CONTAINERS = CONT_ATTR.",
    "    MODIFY CONTAINERS.",
    "",
    "*   Schleife über die zu einem Container gehörenden Einzelfelder in",
    "*   interner Darstellung",
    "",
    "    LOOP AT FIELDLIST_INT_EXTEND",
    "                WHERE CONT_NAME = CONT_ATTR-NAME",
    "                AND   CONT_TYPE = CONT_ATTR-TYPE.",
    "      FIELD_INT = FIELDLIST_INT_EXTEND-FIELD.",
    "      CASE FIELD_INT-FILL.",
    "        WHEN 'B'.    \"Subscreen",
    "        \"nichts zu tun: ist bereits aufgenommen",
    "        WHEN 'T'.    \"Table Control",
    "        \"nichts zu tun: ist bereits aufgenommen",
    "        WHEN 'I'.    \"TabStrip Control",
    "        \"nichts zu tun: ist bereits aufgenommen",
    "        WHEN 'U'.    \"Custom Control",
    "        \"nichts zu tun: ist bereits aufgenommen",
    "        WHEN OTHERS.",
    "*         Dynprofeld in externer Darstellung initialisieren",
    "          CLEAR DYNP_FIELD_ATTR.",
    "          DYNP_FIELD_ATTR-CONT_TYPE = CONT_ATTR-TYPE.",
    "          DYNP_FIELD_ATTR-CONT_NAME = CONT_ATTR-NAME.",
    "",
    "*         Zuordnungen Feld -> Feld",
    "          PERFORM R_ASSIGN_FIELD_FIELD_TO_FIELD",
    "               USING     FIELD_INT",
    "               CHANGING  DYNP_FIELD_ATTR.",
    "",
    "*         Zuordnungen Bit  -> Feld",
    "          PERFORM R_ASSIGN_FIELD_BIT_TO_FIELD",
    "               USING     FIELD_INT",
    "               CHANGING  DYNP_FIELD_ATTR.",
    "",
    "*         spezielle Zuordnungen",
    "",
    "          PERFORM R_TYPE_OUT                     \"Typ",
    "               USING     FIELD_INT",
    "               CHANGING  DYNP_FIELD_ATTR.",
    "",
    "          PERFORM R_TEXT_AND_ICON_OUT            \"Text und Ikone",
    "               USING     FIELD_INT",
    "               CHANGING  DYNP_FIELD_ATTR.",
    "",
    "          PERFORM R_FUNC_OUT                     \"Funktionscode, -typ",
    "               USING     FIELD_INT",
    "               CHANGING  DYNP_FIELD_ATTR.",
    "",
    "          PERFORM R_MODIFIC_OUT                  \"Dict-Modifikation",
    "               USING     FIELD_INT",
    "               CHANGING  DYNP_FIELD_ATTR.",
    "",
    "          PERFORM R_INPUT_FIELD_OUT              \"Eingabefeld",
    "               USING     FIELD_INT",
    "               CHANGING  DYNP_FIELD_ATTR.",
    "",
    "          PERFORM R_POSS_ENTRY_OUT               \"Werthilfetaste",
    "               USING     FIELD_INT",
    "               CHANGING  DYNP_FIELD_ATTR.",
    "",
    "          PERFORM R_RES1_OUT                     \"RES1-Bereich",
    "               USING     FIELD_INT",
    "               CHANGING  DYNP_FIELD_ATTR.",
    "",
    "          PERFORM R_PROPERTIES_OUT               \"Properties",
    "               USING     FIELD_INT",
    "                         r_property_bag",
    "                         r_cntcmp",
    "               CHANGING  DYNP_FIELD_ATTR.",
    "",
    "          PERFORM R_LEAD_ZEROS_OUT               \"führende Nullen",
    "               USING     FIELD_INT",
    "               CHANGING  DYNP_FIELD_ATTR.",
    "",
    "          PERFORM R_TC_ATTRIBUTES_OUT            \"Felder eines TC:",
    "               USING     FIELD_INT               \"  Spaltenmark., Titel,",
    "               CHANGING  DYNP_FIELD_ATTR.        \"  Spaltenüberschr.",
    "",
    "*         Feld in Liste der zum Container gehörenden Felder aufnehmen",
    "          APPEND DYNP_FIELD_ATTR TO FIELDS_TO_CONTAINERS.",
    "",
    "      ENDCASE.",
    "    ENDLOOP.",
    "",
    "*   bei Radio/Checkbuttons: Zusammenfassen von Button und Text zu einem",
    "*   einzig externen Feld und Setzen des Stellungsattributes",
    "    PERFORM R_MODIFY_BUTTONS_OUT",
    "        TABLES FIELDLIST_INT_EXTEND",
    "               FIELDS_TO_CONTAINERS",
    "        USING  CONT_ATTR.",
    "    MODIFY CONTAINERS.",
    "  ENDLOOP.",
    "",
    "*-----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "* 2. Dynproheader (allg. Attribute)",
    "*-----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "",
    "* Zuordnungen Feld --> Feld",
    "  PERFORM R_ASSIGN_HEADER_FIELD_TO_FIELD",
    "              USING    HEADER_INT",
    "              CHANGING DYNP_HEADER.",
    "",
    "* Zuordnungen Bit --> Feld",
    "  PERFORM R_ASSIGN_HEADER_BIT_TO_FIELD",
    "              USING    HEADER_INT",
    "              CHANGING DYNP_HEADER.",
    "",
    "* Dynpro-Beschreibungstext",
    "  DYNP_HEADER-DESCRIPT = DESCRIPT.",
    "  HEADER = DYNP_HEADER.",
    "",
    "*-----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "* 3. Dynproparameter",
    "*-----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "",
    "  REFRESH PARAMS.",
    "",
    "* Parameter-Info, die in DYNP_PARAM (PARAMS) abgelegt wird",
    "  PERFORM R_PARAMS_para",
    "                 tables   PARAMS_INT",
    "                          params.",
    "* Parameter-Info, die in DYNP_HEADER (HEADER) abgelegt wird",
    "  perFORM R_PARAMS_HEAD",
    "                 tables   PARAMS_INT",
    "                 CHANGING HEADER.",
    "",
    "ENDFUNCTION."
  ],
